name: authoring-connector-choice-github-prod-default
description: Connector choice across two GitHub connectors on the same base URL, one dev and one prod, where the dev connector sorts first by name. When generation aborts with a connector_choice need, author_workflow does not retry or guess: it returns requires_user_input with a prefilled ask_user_choice whose default is the prod connector (chosen by environment, not by name order) and whose options list both. One generation pass, draft unchanged, no live HTTP.
failure_class: generator cannot tell which of several GitHub connectors is production

input.goal: Post a daily summary of new issues in the app repository.

abort.reason: two GitHub connectors could read this repository

needs.question: Which GitHub connector should read the repository?
